text: {"rules":[{"id":"SYPHILIS-SCREEN-INCREASED-RISK","version":"September 2022","title":"Syphilis screening in asymptomatic, nonpregnant adolescents and adults at increased risk","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for syphilis infection in persons who are at increased risk for infection.","grade":"A","effective_date":"September 2022","action":"Screen for syphilis infection in asymptomatic, nonpregnant adolescents and adults who are at increased risk for syphilis infection.","denominator":"{\"all\":[{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"clinician assessment of increased risk for syphilis infection (sexual behavior, HIV status, incarceration history, sex work, other risk factors)\"},\"quote\":\"persons who are at increased risk for infection\"},{\"not\":{\"condition\":{\"concept\":\"pregnancy\"},\"quote\":\"nonpregnant\"},\"quote\":\"nonpregnant\"},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"absence of symptoms of syphilis (symptom status not reliably held in structured data)\"},\"quote\":\"asymptomatic\"},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"adolescent or adult status; text gives no numeric lower age bound\"},\"quote\":\"adolescents and adults\"}],\"quote\":\"asymptomatic, nonpregnant adolescents and adults who are at increased risk for syphilis infection\"}","numerator":"{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"syphilis_test\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"screening for syphilis infection\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"section states no screening interval; measurement-year window chosen as a default check period and requires human review\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The section states no screening interval; the measurement-year numerator window is an assumption, declared as derived and requiring human review.","'Increased risk for syphilis infection' is not defined in this section; risk factors (e.g., sexual behavior, HIV status, incarceration, sex work) are encoded as uncomputable.","'Asymptomatic' is encoded as uncomputable because symptom status is not reliably held in structured EHR data.","'Adolescents and adults' has no numeric age bound in the text, so no computable age criterion was added; it is encoded as uncomputable.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('September 2022 *') whose footnote is not included in this section and could not be represented.","Pregnant persons are excluded from this population via the 'nonpregnant' qualifier; syphilis screening in pregnancy is a separate recommendation not covered here.","Screening test choice (treponemal/nontreponemal sequence) and confirmatory testing are not specified in the section and are not represented."]}
